# Mental Health, Gun Violence, and Parenting - Part 2

> If you want to improve your physical health, get into better physical shape do you know what to do? Of course you do! What do you need to do to get into good mental and emotional health? Do you know? Hard to know the answer when you don’t even know what being in good emotional and mental health means.
